opportunities.eligibility: Official materials state applicants typically hold a first-class honours degree or equivalent in computer science or a numerate discipline with significant relevant preparation. Offers are usually conditional, including funding and English language conditions as applied by Postgraduate Admissions.
opportunities.title: PhD in Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official CST PhD page states the PhD is a three-to-four year full-time research degree (or five-to-seven year part-time). Applications for the academic term commencing January 2027 are open, with a funding-competition complete-application deadline of 23:59 GMT on 4 October 2026. For academic year 2027-28, applications opened in September 2026; Gates Cambridge US-resident deadline 14 October 2026; Gates Cambridge and other Cambridge Trusts deadline 8 December 2026; department awards for Home fees students 8 December 2026; final deadline 13 May 2027 for students with full overseas-government scholarships; admission 1 October 2027. Applicants should discuss proposed research with a potential supervisor before applying.
